horizontal_support_policy: Retain all64 original section/date cases,all candidate scores/local maxima and every no-selection,gate/support-edge or primary-censored result. Partition interiors do not overlap;one shared latitude boundary is allowed. A shared-boundary winner is an edge case under frozen selection and cannot be admitted as two independent profiles. No post-result tuning,physical front classification or independent persistent-jet assertion. Distinct contexts may sample a moving flow at different times.
vertical_operator: Frozen connected-layer tracing searches above/below0-200m seeds on full native0-5000m support using adjacent finite brackets. Keep upper/lower contours,statuses,last supported bounds and paired span distinct. SAC primarily-upper1000m and1500m geostrophic reference,Norfolk approximate800m mean/reference,mooring depths,bed and missing limits are not physical bottoms. Never bridge sign/cutoff/missing gaps or inherit EAC/EAUC depths. Same-sign deep flow may connect;model span is not physical thickness.
processing_policy: Cloud-only sequential full-section acquisition,selection,threshold diagnosis,audit and tests on one idle CPU. Local metadata/code/source-PDF review/hash retention only;no local ocean-field processing/tests or runtime/UI/browser/server/native/WASM work. Separate source chunks honor unchanged2.5MB file limits.
